learn.faq.title: Answers for Educators
learn.faq.description: Everything you need to know about starting with AvalAmooz.
learn.faq.1.question: Are courses and worksheets aligned with the latest official textbooks?
learn.faq.1.answer: Yes, 100% of our materials and lesson plans follow the official textbook editions and syllabus timeline.
learn.faq.2.question: What formats are printables provided in, and how are they printed?
learn.faq.2.answer: All worksheets are delivered in high-resolution vector PDF format, optimized for A4 black-and-white or color printing without ink waste or annoying watermarks. Lesson plans are provided in both Word and PDF.
learn.faq.3.question: Do teachers receive verified completion certificates?
learn.faq.3.answer: Yes, completing our professional workshops earns you a digital certificate with a verifiable ID code suitable for resumes and professional portfolios.
learn.faq.4.question: When will grades 2 through 6 be available?
learn.faq.4.answer: AvalAmooz launched with an in-depth focus on Grade 1 as the cornerstone of elementary education. Grades 2-6 are currently in active development and will be rolled out during the academic year.
